chat.description: The chat's key, as the chats tool lists it: "<account>:<chat id>".

text.description: The message's text in Telegram's Markdown, as the user's field takes it: **bold**, __italic__, ~~strikethrough~~, ||spoiler||, `code`, ```code block```, [text](address). At most 4096 characters.

reply_to.description: The id of the message this one answers (the [id] of a line read_chat or search_chat showed): sent as a reply, quoting it. None — a new message.
